execution_anchors.1: Expresses interest or shares an idea only.
execution_anchors.2: Contributed a scoped task or supported someone else's delivery.
execution_anchors.3: Owned a deliverable through completion with a concrete result.
execution_anchors.4: Owned a project end to end, coordinated delivery, and reports a concrete outcome.
execution_anchors.5: Repeated end-to-end delivery with concrete outcomes and evidence of iteration.
